title: Centralized API Gateway & Rate Limiting Service
summary: A unified NestJS API gateway handling authentication, rate limiting, request validation and downstream routing.

components.name: Rate limiter
components.description: Per-IP and per-user limits via Redis sliding-window counters, with HTTP 429 throttling.

components.name: Validation
components.description: Consolidated request validation, logging and health checks with fallback handling.

components.name: Routing
components.description: Routes authorised requests to downstream internal services.

contributions: Implemented a unified API gateway in NestJS handling authentication, rate limiting, request validation, and downstream routing — reducing cross-service redundancy by 60%.
Enforced dual-layer security (JWT + API-key) blocking 100% of unauthorized traffic before reaching internal services.
Applied per-IP and per-user rate limiting via Redis sliding-window counters with HTTP 429 throttling for abuse prevention.
Consolidated validation, logging, and health checks with fallback handling, improving overall service resilience by 50%.

title: Real-time Notification Engine
summary: An event-driven, multi-channel notification platform delivering SMS, email and push messages through RabbitMQ.

components.name: Fan-out exchange
components.description: RabbitMQ fan-out exchange distributing events to every channel.

components.name: Channel queues
components.description: Isolated queues per channel type (SMS, email, push), plus dedicated priority queues for OTPs.

components.name: Dead-letter queue
components.description: Exponential backoff retries under downstream failures.

contributions: Architected an event-driven multi-channel notification platform using RabbitMQ fan-out exchanges, guaranteeing bulk delivery of 300,000+ messages across SMS, email, and push channels with isolated queues per channel type.

Enforced end-to-end security for sensitive personal messages (OTPs) via encrypted payloads and dedicated priority queues — ensuring zero cross-tenant data leakage and 100% isolation between bulk and secure pipelines.
Implemented dead-letter queue handling with exponential backoff retry logic, achieving 98% delivery success rate under downstream failures with full SQL-backed delivery audit logs.
